verdict.rationale: Ashby Assistant is documented as a chat-based agent where you ask questions in plain language and take actions across Ashby, such as analyzing pipelines, updating candidates and drafting emails. It works in-app and from Slack, supports custom agents for repeated workflows, and respects existing permissions. An official MCP server also lets external AI clients like ChatGPT and Claude work with Ashby data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the Assistant works as described, and detailed docs on which write actions natural-language commands can perform and their limits.
